reviews.title: Good solid cooler with copper and 4 heat pipes
reviews.comment: Copper heat plate with 4 heat pipes. The fan is effective and quiet. This reminds me so much if the CoolerMaster type CPU coolers. I'm not saying anything other than the diamond shape on the unit could easily "look a lot" like a CoolerMaster. That's a good thing because CoolerMaster has some very good CPU coolers. It's smaller than some coolers I've had. This may be good for you if you are using a micro case or similar. It cools well, but id like at least one more mount point to install another fan for more serious OC goodness. ( So that one draws in, and the other blows outward). I've found that combo unbeatable! And in some cases better than some water cooling assemblies. For the price, it's great. It's hard to find copper and at least 4 heat pipes in this price range. This one has it. Black is ok, but shiny chrome would be amazing with RGB lighting bouncing around.
reviews.author: 3fingers
